We need to use valid functional groups. The bond we want to break is a C-N bond connecting benzylic carbon to N of azetidine. That is a secondary amine? The side chain includes CN2CC(F)C2 which is a tertiary amine? Actually N2CC(F)C2 is a azetidine ring with fluorine. The bond is between benzyl carbon and nitrogen (C-N). That is a "secondary amine" functional group? The molecule has a secondary amine (benzyl-N). So functional group "secondary amines" is valid.

Let's search with functional_groups_broken ["secondary amines"].
